A note on the room

Materials & image credits

The paintings are Randall Farmer’s original work. Their framed display images preserve their real, original frames; close-up views show the approved digital painting masters. No AI-generated versions of the paintings are used.

Wall art and photographic materials

  • Old wooden dark board by AS Photography / WDnet Studio, via Wikimedia Commons, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Used as a cropped, darkened page texture with CSS overlays.
  • The Victorian burgundy-and-gold wall illustrations were created specifically for the Reliquary, in desktop and portrait mobile versions. These are self-hosted background illustrations, not repeating photographic textures.

The optimized wall backgrounds and wood texture are bundled with the gallery, so the page does not need to fetch its backgrounds from a third-party host.
